title: Bitcoin Could Outperform Most Assets, JPMorgan Says — But the Bank Still Won’t Recommend It
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Could Outperform Most Assets, JPMorgan Says — But the Bank Still Won’t Recommend It The bank has said bitcoin could do better than stocks and bonds over the next 10 years but says it is still too volatile. This post Bitcoin Could Outperform Most Assets, JPMorgan Says — But the Bank Still Won’t Recommend It first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
